bugs.error_message: sqlalchemy.exc.OperationalError: (sqlite3.OperationalError) no such table: uploads / accounts
bugs.root_cause: db_session fixture created the SQLite in-memory engine with create_engine('sqlite:///:memory:', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False}) but no poolclass override. FastAPI's TestClient runs request handlers (both async and sync def routes) through an anyio worker thread that is different from the thread that ran Base.metadata.create_all(engine) and from the fixture's own thread. Without StaticPool, each thread checkout from the default pool got its own separate SQLite ':memory:' database, so the tables created in the test thread did not exist in the request-handling thread.
bugs.fix: Added poolclass=StaticPool to the create_engine() call in the db_session fixture so all sessions/threads share the single in-memory connection.

bugs.error_message: npx tailwindcss init -p failed with 'could not determine executable to run'
bugs.root_cause: `npm install -D tailwindcss` (no version pin) installed Tailwind v4, which removed the `tailwindcss init` CLI command and changed the PostCSS plugin/config model entirely. The task brief's tailwind.config.js/postcss.config.js/@tailwind directive content is v3-only.
bugs.fix: Uninstalled tailwindcss and reinstalled with `npm install -D tailwindcss@^3` to match the brief's config format exactly.

bugs.error_message: Error: Cannot find module 'tslib' (required by react-remove-scroll, a transitive dep of @radix-ui/react-select)
bugs.root_cause: react-remove-scroll's es5 build requires tslib at runtime but does not declare/hoist it correctly, so it was absent from node_modules even though @radix-ui/react-select was installed.
bugs.fix: Ran `npm install tslib` as a direct dependency.

bugs.error_message: TypeError: target.hasPointerCapture is not a function (thrown inside @radix-ui/react-select during userEvent.click in tests); also 'Found multiple elements with role combobox' across tests
bugs.root_cause: jsdom does not implement Element.hasPointerCapture/setPointerCapture/releasePointerCapture/scrollIntoView, which Radix UI Select's pointer-interaction code calls directly. Separately, RTL does not auto-cleanup after each test under Vitest unless `test.globals: true` is set or cleanup is called explicitly, so a second test's render leaves duplicate DOM from the first.
bugs.fix: Added no-op polyfills for hasPointerCapture/setPointerCapture/releasePointerCapture/scrollIntoView on Element.prototype in setupTests.ts, and added an explicit `afterEach(() => cleanup())` using @testing-library/react's cleanup.
Changed scopeId: null, setRole → number | null
